scope: Read-only pinned extracted TXD metadata inventory through existing texture profile entrypoint; no ISO or registry writes.

candidates.decision: Retain decode/replace signature and responsibilities. Widening return type would spread changes through52 test references and authoring/self calls. An inventory raster-policy sentinel would mix structural discovery with calibration/pixel rules.
Enhance existing profile operation dispatch/source pin checks/reporting for inventory; it is not a second structural parser or raster decoder.
ELF/registry reference and structural text scan owner; unsuitable for RW/TXD metadata.

new_function_justification.name: indexTextures
new_function_justification.why_unavoidable: Existing texture can reasonably reuse a pure bounded structural parser, but cannot own a useful metadata inventory through its current bytes/image result contract without an unrelated output/mode or breaking all codec callers. Extract its existing RW traversal into one shared index owner; both texture and authorTexture reuse it. No new executor/writer/helper/test function.

contract: Preserve global dictionary/native envelope/name refusals and limits.

Per-entry metadata errors remain local; texture rejects selected errors and duplicate/missing selectors under existing policy. Malformed unselected raster structs must not cause a new decoder refusal.
Preserve selected cumulative chunk-count limit, not aggregate descent into all unselected raster structures.
Inventory keeps native order and duplicate names; metadata is not format/storage/pixel calibration. Support is not_evaluated.
Inventory forbids selector/PNG/render/palette/pixel/rectangle/apply/output inputs; ordinary authoring unchanged.
Existing tests enhanced with multi-native/duplicate/unselected-malformed fixtures, metadata-only unsupported data and CLI no-write checks.
independent_design_review: Read-only exact_palette_review recommendation2026-10-20; no implementation or approval authority.
claims: Capability growth and shared structural owner extraction, not code reduction or historical retirement. Full-family score remains5/14.
